question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**becomes**" means to begin to be or come to be something. (बन जाता है)
 
• In this context, **"becomes" **appropriately fills the blank, indicating that literature transitions into a timeless portal for exploring diverse worlds and cultures.
 
• The other options: "**became**", "**become**", and "**becoming**" do not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In a rapidly changing world, literature becomes__ a timeless portal to diverse worlds and cultures.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Became (बन गया)**: is the past tense of become and indicates a completed action in the past, not suitable for the context referring to an ongoing state.
 
• **Become (बनना)**: is an infinitive verb that does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• **Becoming (बन रहा)**: is the present participle and does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
